title: Repairs.
officialText:
Scaffolds, all components of and attachments to the scaffold, and all supports and anchorages of the scaffold
installed at a site shall be repaired under the supervision of a competent person designated by the equipment owner. Individuals
who perform repairs, and the person supervising such, shall be trained in accordance with Section 3314.4.5. Following the
repair, the scaffold shall be inspected in accordance with Section 3314.4.3.6.
Exceptions:
1. Where a sidewalk shed provides the base for a supported scaffold, the sidewalk shed shall be repaired in
accordance with the requirements of Section 3307.6.
2. Components and attachments may be replaced under the supervision of a competent person designated by the
contractor or licensee who installed the scaffold.
